scientific_integrity: Sharp bounds and equality sets supported by finite exhaustive algebraic computation plus a proof reducing the global questions to those finite cases. Self-review only, not independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Only exact Euclidean regular rhombic triacontahedron; full shadow-area law, nonregular deformations and comprehensive historical priority unresolved. First two moments only.
title: Sharp brightness extrema and exact orientation moments of the regular rhombic triacontahedron
